properties.address: 46. Dragon Lane, Whiston, Prescot, Merseyside L35 2UG
properties.summary:
This three-bedroom semi-detached house in Whiston is for sale by auction, offered with vacant possession and freehold tenure. It sits on a generous plot with a long rear garden and offers around 846 sq. ft. of accommodation, including a living room with bay window, separate dining room, kitchen and bathroom.

The property would benefit from modernisation and cosmetic improvements throughout. Whiston railway station is nearby, with links to Liverpool and Manchester, and the area has convenient access to the motorway network.

This four-bedroom semi-detached house in Selborne, Whiston, is offered for sale with no onward chain. Accommodation includes an entrance hall, cloakroom, lounge, dining kitchen, study/storage area, four bedrooms and a shower room. The property is described as needing some modernisation and is of non standard construction, so buyers should consult their mortgage provider before committing.

Externally there is a paved patio and lawned rear garden with a large workshop, a car port at the side and a front garden with driveway parking. The agent notes proximity to local schools, transport links and Whiston Hospital. The EPC rating is C.

This three-bedroom semi-detached house offers practical family living with a bright, well-maintained interior. The ground floor features a spacious living room with large windows, separate dining room, contemporary fitted kitchen, and useful external storage rooms alongside a side passage.

Upstairs provides three well-sized bedrooms and a family bathroom. The property benefits from a generous, mature rear garden ideal for landscaping or recreation, set well back from the road for privacy. Located near Prescot Railway Station, town centre amenities, and excellent motorway links.

properties.address: Longview Road, Prescot, St Helens L35
properties.summary:
This two-bedroom semi-detached house on Longview Road, Prescot, is offered with no onward chain and sits in a pleasant position just off Warrington Road. The ground floor provides a lounge, separate dining room and kitchen, with two double bedrooms and a family bathroom upstairs. The property would benefit from modernisation and upgrading.

Externally, there is a generous rear garden with mature planting and off-road parking to the front. The house is within walking distance of Whiston Hospital, with nearby retail facilities, schooling, bus routes and motorway access. The EPC rating is F.

properties.address: Fire Station Road, Whiston, Prescot, Merseyside, L35
properties.summary:
This three-bedroom terraced house is being sold by Modern Method of Auction with no onward chain, offering a reliable transaction. The property features a spacious living room, open-plan kitchen/dining area, downstairs W.C, sun room/conservatory, and generously sized rear garden.

The front benefits from a paved driveway providing off-road parking and adjacent garage space. Three upstairs bedrooms, family bathroom, and separate W.C complete the accommodation. Located on Fire Station Road in Whiston, the property is within walking distance of a public park.
This semi-detached house has been sitting on the market since October 2025. The asking price has been reduced 4 times by a total of 17% from the first listing price.

properties.address: 6 Long Hey, Whiston, Prescot, Merseyside, L35 3JW
properties.summary:
This three-bedroom semi-detached house will be sold by auction on 3rd November 2026. It features a living room/dining room and kitchen on the ground floor, three bedrooms and a bathroom upstairs, plus front and rear gardens, driveway and garage.

Located in a well-established residential area off Windy Arbour Road, close to local amenities, schools and transport links. Within walking distance of a public playing field. Following refurbishment, the property would be suitable for occupation, resale or investment, with potential rental of approximately £13,200 per annum.

This three-bedroom semi-detached property on Pottery Lane is sold with no onward chain, providing a more straightforward transaction. The extended home requires updating but offers excellent potential for improvement and modernisation to suit your taste.

Spacious accommodation includes two reception rooms, breakfast kitchen, and downstairs cloaks. Upstairs are three well-proportioned bedrooms and family bathroom. External features comprise off-road parking, large rear garden, and workshop. Ideally positioned for families, first-time buyers, or investors.

This three-bedroom semi-detached property is being sold by online auction with established tenants in situ, currently achieving £775 per calendar month (£9,300 annually). An excellent investment opportunity offering immediate rental income from completion.

Well-presented accommodation includes a spacious lounge with feature fireplace, fitted kitchen with integrated appliances, modern bathroom and three bedrooms. Front and rear gardens with decked seating area, driveway and off-road parking. Conveniently located near Whiston Village, train station, schools and motorway links.

This freehold block comprises two self-contained two-bedroom duplex apartments on Kemble Street, Prescot, being sold by auction. Both units are ready to let immediately, offering investors strong rental potential with anticipated annual income of approximately £18,600 (11.6% gross yield).

Each duplex is arranged over two levels with practical accommodation including reception rooms, fitted kitchens, and bathrooms. The property benefits from rear garden and parking, plus convenient access to Prescot High Street's shops, amenities and transport links.
